title: Write and save a Word document
summary: Open Word, type a letter, save it.

steps.hint: The blue Windows logo at the bottom.

steps.detail: Word is for letters and documents.

steps.text: Dear family, I am learning to use my computer.
steps.say: Click on the page and type: Dear family, I am learning to use my computer.
steps.detail: Word puts your words on a white page.

steps.say: Hold the Ctrl key and tap S.
steps.detail: Ctrl+S means Save. It works in almost every program.

steps.say: Type a name for your letter: my letter
steps.detail: Check that Documents is selected on the left.
The name appears at the top of Word.

steps.say: Click the X to close Word.
steps.detail: Your letter is safe in Documents.
